semiconductor_relevance: High - IHI Ionbond AG provides specialized coating services that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: IHI Ionbond AG specializes in advanced PVD, PACVD, and CVD coating services tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their coatings enhance the performance and durability of components used in wafer handling and vacuum systems, contributing to improved yield and uptime in cleanroom environments.

regional_presence.Europe: IHI Ionbond AG operates multiple coating centers across Europe, providing local accessibility and expertise.
regional_presence.North America: The company has a presence in North America, supporting regional semiconductor manufacturing needs.
regional_presence.Asia: IHI Ionbond AG extends its services to Asia, enhancing its global coating network.
